claim: NOT clean, and unchanged from the previous record. First klt drc run at the current pin (klt 0.9.2) on the currently committed layout/slice_routed.gds and layout/lane_column.gds, per issue #64 Revision 2. The stream hashes changed after the r3 record (DEF-PINS fix, commit 9494c37) and no DRC record carried either hash; the pin moved 0.9.1 -> 0.9.2 and the packaged deck changed with it. Every per-rule count is byte-identical to r3: nothing moved. Layout results against a predictive PDK, not measurements. Not T1 item 3 evidence; the manifest does not cite it and item 3 stays unmet. Nothing waived, filtered or relaxed: the packaged ASAP7 deck and the full 267-id rule-category expectation set are unmodified, no --rules, no --waivers. Both runs completed; the summary-only envelopes are committed alongside this record.
